class.name: IfcConnectionVolumeGeometry
class.brief_description: IfcConnectionVolumeGeometry is used to describe the geometric constraints that facilitate the physical connection (or overlap) of two objects at a volume defined by a solid or closed shell. It is envisioned as a control that applies to the element connection or interference relationships. HISTORYÿ New entity in IFC2x4.
